#   asserted  the probe CLAIMS it with covers("Class", "selector", assertion), so the claim

#             tier that means the selector is PROVED.
#   named     the probe names the selector (an @selector or a bare literal, as the inventory
#             arrays do). The probe TOUCHES it; nothing is claimed to be asserted.
#   none      nothing touches it. Every such row is listed below.
